steps.text: 'The Shangshu Mountains are full of walkways, winding through its steep peaks among the clouds.'
A conspicuous sign stands here. The sign itself is new, and so are the letters written upon it. The words, however, are old.
The mountain is old, and so are the stone steps. The cable cars and the people, however, are all new.
I scratch my head and am surprised to find my hair less of a damp mess than expected. It is as though some indescribable sensation is enlightening my entire body and soul.
All one's vivid daytime memories quickly fade away. Yet, they thoughtfully drift back when needed.
I decide to make my way up.
I am not sure why I do so, but even if these steps took me immediately heavenward, I would still ascend.
As if in response to my sincerity, I find yet another sign around the corner.
A new sign, this time accompanied by new words. It resembles one that advertises scenic spots for tourists.
'Zuanjiang Peak'

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Zuanjiang Peak... Is that where I am?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Hello—Anybody home—

steps.name: Faint Echo
steps.text: Hello... Anybody home...

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Fine. Now that I'm here, might as well make the best of this.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: (There seems to be a pavilion in the distance.)

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: (Strange... I feels like I've seen this place before...)

steps.name: Snowsweeping Stranger
steps.text: We don't often get visitors here. Are you heading to the pavilion?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Oh, no... I'm just going to take a peek.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: What is this place...?

steps.name: Snowsweeping Stranger
steps.text: Zuanjiang Peak.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: One of Shangshu's Three Mounts and Seventeen Peaks?

steps.name: Snowsweeping Stranger
steps.text: Eighteen, not Seventeen.

steps.name: Snowsweeping Stranger
steps.text: The path to the pavilion isn't an easy one. Someone must have had a lot of free time to build it up there.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Looks like there's somebody up there though...?

steps.name: Snowsweeping Stranger
steps.text: Of course. Why else would you build a pavilion?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: And you're sweeping snow here?

steps.name: Snowsweeping Stranger
steps.text: Correct.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: There's nobody here.

steps.name: Snowsweeping Stranger
steps.text: They'll only come after the snow is cleared.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Who will?

steps.name: Snowsweeping Stranger
steps.text: Who knows, but you're here now, aren't you?

steps.name: Snowsweeping Stranger
steps.text: Isn't the one at the pavilion beckoning you?

steps.name: Snowsweeping Stranger
steps.text: Watch your step.

steps.name: Snowsweeping Stranger
steps.text: The path is slippery when it's snowy.

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: Is everyone here?

steps.name: Street Youth
steps.text: Correct.

steps.name: Street Youth
steps.text: The masters won't let us in on the fun, and the innkeeper is always busy with his customers. The only ones missing are those still sitting around waiting for table scraps.

steps.name: Feeble Apprentice
steps.text: Are you sure we don't have to listen to I-Innkeeper Zheng...? Can we back out?

steps.name: Street Youth
steps.text: Huh? You still wanna follow him? Might as well quit martial arts and work as one of his cooks!

steps.name: Street Youth
steps.text: All the logistics companies have gotta be swimming in dough, with how busy they are. But, no, the old man is so in love with his rules that he'd rather open a restaurant than compete! He must be senile or something!

steps.name: Feeble Apprentice
steps.text: To Innkeeper Zheng, a restaurant is an upstanding business, while attaching the word 'logistics' to the Xingyu name would merely sully the Association. He'd never accept that.

steps.name: Street Youth
steps.text: And why does he think that?

steps.name: Feeble Apprentice
steps.text: How would I know?

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: We all know old man Zheng's scared of everything these days. After all those years running the Escort Association, only now when he's about to kick the bucket does he realize how many people he's offended for nothing.

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: At this rate, the Association is done for, with or without anyone kicking down our doors.

steps.name: Street Youth
steps.text: But this is a huge job from the court, right? You sure it's okay to screw it up on purpose?

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: This will only work because it's a huge job. I know what I'm doing.

steps.name: Distant Shout
steps.text: Help! Thief!

steps.name: Distant Shout
steps.text: Don't let him get away!

steps.name: Street Youth
steps.text: Uh... is that part of your plan too, Miss Du?

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: Of course not! Let's go!

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: It seems your friend is asleep.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: Well, it's getting awfully late...

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: After nothing but small talk?

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: Then what of the play...?

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: We'll discuss this another time. You should rest. Try not to go outside so often.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: You need to take care of yourself.

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: I visit because there are matters more pressing to me than my health.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: You mean the plays...?

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: Mm-hm.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: I can't leave while I still have duties to attend to.

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: Is that your way of berating me for idling about all day?

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: Of course not.

steps.name: Distant Shout
steps.text: Help! Thief!

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: Hm... A thief?

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: How bizarre... A thief at the Liang estate?

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: You head on inside. I will take a look.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: What is going on here?

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Oh, Mr. Liang. I just arrived myself.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: You two are Lee's guests, and that makes you my guests as well. As your host, I apologize for the disturbance.

steps.name: Part-Timer
steps.text: M-Mr. Liang. I was just preparing to leave for the day, when all of a sudden I saw a silhouette up on the wall...

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: A silhouette?

steps.name: Part-Timer
steps.text: Y-Yes, and it looked like it was holding a box...

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: To Lee's room! Hurry!

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: The lady sweeping snow was right, it was a difficult climb. And now that I made it, the person I saw is gone.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Hey, are you still here—?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: What is this place anyway...?

a.text: The pinnacle of your hike. In other words, the summit.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Why did you summon me here?

a.text: You are the one who called me.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: I did?

steps.name: Lee?
steps.text: Right...

steps.name: Lee?
steps.text: I'm here... to reminisce with you, about the old days.

steps.name: Lee?
steps.text: I'll pass... There's no suspense to it, much less any enjoyment.

a.text: So you only want a drinking buddy, then?

steps.name: Lee?
steps.text: I'm here to give you a small gift.

a.text: It's been decades since we last met. Forget the gift; it's the thought that counts.

steps.name: Lee?
steps.text: Only a few decades. Like the snap of a finger.

steps.name: Lee?
steps.text: A pair, one black and one white, like light and shadow coexisting in harmony.

steps.name: Lee?
steps.text: Pick one, and I'll keep the other.

steps.name: Lee?
steps.text: What's the matter? Not to your liking?

a.text: You can fool others, and you can fool our other siblings, but you can't fool me.
Are you not afraid of losing this whole game?

steps.name: Lee?
steps.text: I am, yet also not.

steps.name: Lee?
steps.text: Besides, I didn't exactly have a choice—

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Hm... Was that... all a dream?

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: Are you okay?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: I'm not so old that you need to worry about me kicking the bucket in my sleep... What's the matter?

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Sir, someone just spotted a thief making off with a case that looked just like yours!

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: Is the case gone?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: You mean the wine cup...? Don't worry. It's right here.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: How did you...?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: The box only contains an ordinary teapot I took from the cupboard, painted black with ink.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: I'm not stupid enough to leave it out in the open, knowing someone is after it.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: My good man, you are every bit the cunning genius that Kroos described.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Mr. Liang.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Someone out there is bold enough to provoke the magistrate for an old antique. If every thief were this brazen, the L.G.D. would only need to guard street food stands.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: So isn't it time you told me what this is about?

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: I will tell you everything you need to know.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: Which also coincides with the other matter I need your help with.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: Find its owner.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: I see... Some actual detective work this time.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Before that though... Mr. Nothing, where's that benefactor of yours, Kroos?

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Uh... D-Did she chase after them?!

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: I'll go check on her!

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: (I followed them all the way to this night market, but isn't it a bit too lively?)

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: (Did I lose 'em?)

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: (Let me check this direction...)

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Oops, my bad—

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: —You're from this afternoon—

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: I don't suppose you'd believe me if I said I had nothing to do with this?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: I haven't even said anything yet.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: But put yourself in my shoes. Soon as I arrive in Shangshu, I run into someone trying to rob a friend. And now again. Would YOU believe that's a coincidence?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Don't worry though, I'll give you plenty of time to work out your excuse.

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: Hmph.

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: Might as well save my breath, then!

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: I'll go this way. You check over there.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Right then! I'm counting on you, Brother Lee.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Hold on.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Is something the matter?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: What's that... beside your feet?

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Hm? I don't see anything.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Must be my eyes playing tricks... Maybe someone's pet?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Let's go.
